name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-int-as-byte-3055-p.bal
reason: The case asserts that casting the int value 3055 to byte panics because it is outside the byte range. test_design_notes: The // @panic marker asserts runtime failure at the cast; it is not a language annotation.
